title: Granular
description: Cuts the sound into short windowed grains and scatters them along its length (with a little pitch variation): a longer, never repeating texture from a short sound.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: scatter
parameters.doc: How far a grain may come from the place it would have in the original (0 follows the original).

parameters.name: pitch
parameters.doc: Random pitch variation of a grain, up or down, in semitones.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
